newsitem.title: USA: IBM Credit Corp Q2 net falls 7 pct.
newsitem.headline: IBM Credit Corp Q2 net falls 7 pct.

text.p: IBM Credit Corp on Monday said net earnings in the second quarter fell seven percent to $68.6 million from $74.1 million in the year-earlier period.

The company, a wholly owned financing and leasing subsidiary of International Business Machines Corp, said return on average equity for the period was 20 percent, compared with 23.8 percent in the second quarter of 1996.
Capital equipment financing originated for end users rose 24 percent to $1,57 million from $1.27 million.
Working capital financing originated for distribution channels increased by 17 percent to $3.67 million from $3.14 million.
IBM said total assets of the unit were $14.4 billion at the end of the second quarter, compared with $12.9 billion on December 31.
